nodes.label: Phase 1 — Proof of Concept
nodes.desc: Validate the core delivery mechanism: can the engineered carrier protein transport fluorescent reporters to the target organelle?

custom.title: Method
custom.content: Confocal fluorescence microscopy (GFP + mCherry dual-channel) in model organism leaf tissue after transformation.

custom.title: Design Rationale
custom.content: Must confirm subcellular transport works before adding the functional cargo. Two-module system: Module 1 = reporter + signal peptides, Module 2 = protease + localization signal.

custom.title: Key Result
custom.content: GFP successfully relocalized to target compartment within 48h. mCherry remained in nucleus. Transport mechanism confirmed.

nodes.label: Constructs
nodes.desc: Expression vectors for the reporter shuttle system.

nodes.label: Assembly Level 1
nodes.desc: Individual modules assembled via modular cloning.

nodes.label: Assembly Level 2
nodes.desc: Final expression vectors combining Level 1 modules.

nodes.label: Controls
nodes.desc: Negative controls to confirm specificity of the transport mechanism.

nodes.label: Phase 2 — Cargo Delivery
nodes.desc: Deliver functional cargo to the target compartment via the validated carrier protein. Detect successful delivery through compartment-specific reporter activity.

custom.title: Method
custom.content: Co-transformation of carrier + cargo constructs. qPCR and reporter assays to detect cargo expression in target compartment.

custom.title: Design Rationale
custom.content: Carrier binds cargo covalently via active-site residue. After protease cleavage, signal peptide pulls the carrier-cargo complex into target organelle. Cargo flanked by homology arms for integration.

custom.title: Next Steps
custom.content: Obtain clean positive + negative control results in a single experiment. Test all four cargo variants.

nodes.label: Strategy A (Direct)
nodes.desc: Primary strategy: deliver cargo directly via carrier protein shuttle.

nodes.label: Cargo Variants
nodes.desc: Different cargo designs testing various origin sequences and promoter configurations.

nodes.label: Carrier Vectors
nodes.desc: Carrier protein constructs for cargo binding and delivery.

nodes.label: Strategy B (Alternative)
nodes.desc: Alternative strategy using RNA-binding proteins for indirect delivery. On hold pending Strategy A results.

custom.title: Note
custom.content: Exploratory — based on earlier pilot study. Will revisit if Strategy A hits a dead end.

nodes.label: Phase 3 — Functional Rescue
nodes.desc: Ultimate goal: restore organelle function by delivering a corrective gene. Demonstrate phenotypic rescue via enzyme activity restoration.

custom.title: Method
custom.content: Native gel electrophoresis to detect enzyme complex assembly. Compare transformed vs. untransformed samples.

custom.title: Success Criteria
custom.content: Restored enzyme band on native gel in transformed samples. Quantifiable by densitometry.

elements.label: VEC-001
elements.desc: Module 1: Constitutive promoter → GFP–cleavage site–signal peptide–mCherry–export signal. Cargo + shuttle signals.

elements.label: VEC-002
elements.desc: Module 2: Constitutive promoter → mCherry–protease(intron)–NLS. Nuclear protease expression.

elements.label: VEC-010
elements.desc: Complete PoC binary vector. Combines @VEC-001 + @VEC-002. Transformation successful, validated by microscopy.

custom.title: Cloning Notes
custom.content: Modular assembly LVL2. Colony PCR: 4/6 positive. Sequencing confirmed correct assembly.

elements.label: CTRL-001 (Δexport)
elements.desc: Negative control: @VEC-010 without export signal. No nuclear processing expected → GFP stays in nucleus.

elements.label: CTRL-002 (Δcleavage)
elements.desc: Negative control: @VEC-010 without cleavage site between export and signal peptide. Protease cannot expose signal → no transport.

elements.label: Confocal Microscopy
elements.desc: Confocal imaging of @VEC-010-transformed tissue. Organelle-specific dye co-staining for localization verification.

custom.title: Microscope Settings
custom.content: Zeiss LSM 880. GFP: 488nm ex / 500-550nm em. mCherry: 561nm ex / 580-630nm em. Organelle dye: 633nm.

elements.label: Western Blot
elements.desc: Anti-GFP western to confirm protease cleavage products in nuclear and organellar fractions.

elements.label: CARGO-v1
elements.desc: Cargo variant 1: Origin-A + target-upstream(430nt) + 150nt reporter + target-downstream. No in vitro site.

elements.label: CARGO-v2
elements.desc: Cargo variant 2: Alternative origin (Origin-B) instead of Origin-A. Testing different replication strategy.

replicates.note: Some clones had deletions, clone 3 correct

elements.label: CARGO-v3
elements.desc: Cargo variant 3: Origin-A + T7 promoter for in vitro single-stranded synthesis. Enables pre-loading carrier with cargo.

elements.label: CARGO-v4
elements.desc: Cargo variant 4: optimized origin + T7 site variant 2. Currently in cloning.

custom.title: Troubleshooting
custom.content: Ligation efficiency low. Switching to higher-concentration ligase and overnight incubation at 16°C. Also testing isothermal assembly as alternative.

elements.label: CAR-001
elements.desc: Carrier protein shuttle backbone (no reporter). Intermediate for @CAR-003.

elements.label: CAR-002 (GFP-tagged)
elements.desc: Carrier–GFP fusion for fluorescence localization tracking. Confirms carrier enters target compartment.

elements.label: CAR-003
elements.desc: Complete carrier binary vector: @CAR-001 + @VEC-002. Ready for co-transformation with cargo.

elements.label: qPCR (reporter editing)
elements.desc: qPCR targeting compartment-specific RNA editing sites. Positive result = cargo transcribed inside target organelle.

replicates.note: No signal — possible genomic DNA contamination
Faint band after DNase treatment — needs replication

custom.title: Protocol
custom.content: RNA extraction → DNase I treatment → RT with gene-specific primer → qPCR → Sanger sequencing of edited positions.

elements.label: Fluorescence Microscopy
elements.desc: Co-localization of @CAR-002 (carrier-GFP) with organelle dye in co-transformed cells.

elements.label: BIND-001
elements.desc: RNA-binding module construct. Delivers target RNA sequence for indirect import.

elements.label: ADAPT-001
elements.desc: Level 1 assembly: Modified backbone for adapter protein expression.

elements.label: ADAPT-002
elements.desc: Level 2 assembly: Combines @ADAPT-001 + protease module. Final alternative strategy vector — not yet assembled.

elements.label: CTRL-MUT (active site)
elements.desc: Critical negative control: @CAR-003 with point mutation in carrier active site. Cannot bind cargo covalently.

custom.title: Mutagenesis
custom.content: Site-directed mutagenesis via overlap extension PCR. Active-site Tyr→Ala. Primer pair validated by Tm calculator.

elements.label: Empty Vector Control
elements.desc: Empty backbone vector. Infiltrated alongside experimental constructs in every co-transformation.

elements.label: Native Gel (Enzyme Complex)
elements.desc: Native gel electrophoresis to detect restored enzyme complex assembly in organellar extracts from transformed tissue.

custom.title: Protocol
custom.content: Organelle isolation → detergent solubilization → native gel → Coomassie or in-gel activity staining.

elements.label: O₂ Consumption Assay
elements.desc: Oxygen consumption rate measurement to quantify restored electron transport chain activity.

elements.label: Growth Phenotype
elements.desc: Compare growth rates of transformed vs. untransformed organisms under stress conditions requiring functional enzyme complex.

elements.label: Chlorophyll Fluorescence
elements.desc: PAM fluorometry to assess photosynthetic efficiency as indirect measure of organelle health.

sections.title: qPCR Troubleshooting
sections.content: Repeated qPCR with strict DNase protocol. Got a faint but reproducible band from @CARGO-v1 + @CAR-003 co-transformed samples. No band in untransformed control — promising! Need to replicate with n=3 before getting excited. Sanger sequencing of the amplicon sent out today.

sections.title: CARGO-v4 Assembly
sections.content: Isothermal assembly attempt #1 failed — no colonies. Suspect the insert:backbone ratio was off. Will gel-purify both fragments and try 3:1 molar ratio tomorrow. Also considering ordering the fragment as a gBlock.

sections.title: Microscopy Session
sections.content: Confocal session for @CAR-002 co-localization. GFP signal clearly in target compartment, but lots of background in the green channel. Need to optimize laser power and detector gain. MitoTracker signal was clean. Will try 488nm at 2% power next time.

sections.title: Meeting with Supervisor
sections.content: Discussed Phase 2 progress. Supervisor suggests prioritizing the @CTRL-MUT control — reviewers will ask for it. Also mentioned we should think about Phase 3 timeline. Native gel protocol from the neighboring lab might work for us.

sections.title: qPCR Results
sections.content: First qPCR attempt after DNase treatment: faint band at correct size! Previous failures were likely gDNA contamination. Protocol change: added extra DNase step + heat inactivation. Need to replicate, but this could be the first evidence of cargo transcription in the target.

sections.title: Failed qPCR
sections.content: qPCR showed signal in both transformed AND untransformed samples — genomic DNA contamination. Need to add rigorous DNase treatment. Ordered TURBO DNase kit. Will also include a no-RT control in every run from now on.

sections.title: CARGO-v4 Cloning
sections.content: Ligation of @CARGO-v4 failed. Colonies on plate but all are empty vector. Gel showed insert band was faint — probably not enough DNA. Will re-digest with fresh enzymes and try higher insert concentration.

sections.title: Phase 1 Complete!
sections.content: Western blot replicate confirmed: protease cleavage products visible at expected sizes in nuclear and organellar fractions. Combined with the microscopy data, Phase 1 is conclusively done. Transport mechanism works. Moving to Phase 2 cargo delivery experiments next week.
